The whole surfa"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ce is exposed over **MCP**, so any MCP-speaking agent can use AItelier as its workflow engine: deleg"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ate bulk work to cheap, deterministic pipelines and only decide at checkpoints (see Use AItelier fro"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"m another agent). Under it all is an open engine (SkillFlow, MIT, on PyPI as `skillflow-py`) plus a "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"flagship software-delivery pipeline; the broader no-code **workflow platform** is on the roadmap."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why AItelier"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Most "AI agent" tooling is built for demos, not trust. The tools that build software or automate a w"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"orkflow for you are non-deterministic black boxes: you can't reproduce a run, audit *why* the agent "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"did what it did, or insert a human approval where it matters. That's exactly the wall that stops age"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"nts from being deployed in anything serious — regulated industries, enterprise, anywhere "it usually"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" works" isn't good enough."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"AItelier is built on the opposite premise — that an autonomous pipeline should be **trustworthy by c"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ilt on the opposite premise — that an autonomous pipeline should be **trustworthy by construction**:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Deterministic execution rules** — workflow graphs are traversed by the engine, not control flow "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"improvised by an LLM. Their conditional outcomes may differ and their retry paths may contain cycles"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"; they are not necessarily DAGs. Loops, gates, retries, and recovery are the engine's job. The separ"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ate project-state dependency graph is acyclic.
- **Minimal LLM surface (least privilege)** — each ag"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ent sees only the context it declares, and the SkillFlow engine generates a constrained **write tool"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" per declared output** (and gates reads to declared context) — so an agent *cannot* read or write a "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"file outside its contract. Concretely in the software pipeline: the Researcher can only search the w"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"eb; every other role can write only its own declared output (a design doc, a plan, a review verdict,"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" or the project README) — and *only* the Implementer's outputs are code. The model makes the judgmen"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"t calls; the framework and its generated tools do everything deterministic — *brain to brain, tools "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"to tools*. It's also why cheap models suffice: small, focused, role-scoped context.
- **Fully tracea"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ble** — every run keeps an append-only audit trace that is *never deleted*: each step, prompt, model"},{"id":"p9s13","text":" response, and tool call. "Why did this run do that?" is one query, not forensic archaeology.
- **Hu"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"man-in-the-loop** — approval/reject checkpoints are first-class between stages; review and send work"},{"id":"p9s15","text":" back with feedback at any point.
- **Adversarial quality** — every step is produced by a Green (Mak"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"er) agent and reviewed by a Red (Checker) agent before it advances.

2. **Build your own auditable workflow — just describe i"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"t** — ✅ *works today.* Pipelines aren't limited to software. **Describe a workflow in chat** (or ove"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"r MCP) and AItelier's grounded generator turns it into a real SkillFlow pipeline — provisioning any "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"missing tools, wiring and gating the graph, and registering it to run by name (see Generate a workfl"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ow from a description). (That's See it in action below — and the proof t"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"hat the engine holds up under the hardest workload.)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Why software-delivery is the wedge _and_ the keystone.** We lead with autonomous software-building"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" because it's the hardest possible proof the engine works — and because **an AI workflow *is* softwa"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"re** (a pipeline is a graph plus tools plus templates). The same deterministic factory that builds s"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"oftware is what will let you *trust a workflow you build on AItelier* — building a new auditable wor"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"kflow is itself a software-engineering task. A trusted software pipeline builds trusted workflows."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Open source.** SkillFlow is the engine and is embeddable in *any* agent system; AItelier is the ho"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"st application around it. The SkillFlow engin"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e owns traversal, tool execution, checkpoints, and the durable trace; AItelier supplies the agents, "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"templates, tools, and UI."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Agents never hold state in memory.
